These fixtures were emitted by the unmodified `v0.1.0` git tag, built with `cargo build --locked --package foldr-cli` on macOS. The recorded temporary paths and identities are intentionally preserved. `snapshot.json` is the original inspect JSON envelope; `preset.toml` is preset save output after setting a UTF-8 note and binary bytes `00ff0a`; `removal.toml` is normalized preset import output with explicit removals. Recovery files are the binary set and removal apply journals. Tests read and roundtrip them without opening their historical targets.
